comments.author: yabones
comments.story: Top passwords used by business executives
comments.text: Interesting that the top name used in passwords is Tiffany. Culturally it has a strong connection to the 80s decade, which points to two specific demographics: ~35 year olds, who might be in a relationship to one, or ~55 year olds who might have one as a daughter. [VIDEO] Makes me wonder if it's time to start generating rainbow tables for the top female names of the 90s and 2000s soon...
